annotations.title: Text embeddings API: 1,024-dimension vectors for semantic search and RAG

description: Text embeddings API: a 1,024-dimension vector for up to 4,000 characters of text in 100+ languages (BAAI BGE-M3), also OpenAI-compatible at /v1/embeddings. Use for semantic search, RAG retrieval, clustering, deduplication and similarity scoring. Example: text=pay-per-call APIs for AI agents. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
